title: How to Make the World a Better Place
intent: Rank interventions by actual increase in ordered useful complexity and reduction of suffering for the least among us.
eta_goal: Replace vague idealism with η-ranked, measurable action.
core_framing: Better is defined as higher ordered complexity that serves life and reduces extractive entropy.
Local, verifiable improvements compound; global rhetoric without local fruit does not.
The least among us are the preferred beneficiaries of any η gain.
optimized_query_patterns: What is the highest-η action I can take this week that measurably improves conditions for someone with less power than I have?
Does this intervention increase or decrease total systemic entropy?
constraints: No virtue signaling without corresponding joules
verification_notes: Before/after measures of local useful complexity or suffering reduction.
next_physical_or_action: Execute one small, measurable improvement for a concrete person or place within seven days.
